compiler_obligation: Reject a backend pass that silently changes already-lowered semantics.
statement: Typed IR lowering chooses semantic operations and representations; code generation begins only when backend/target encodings are selected.

compiler_obligation: Record both template and generated-source identities.
statement: A source template is a parameterized generator input; generated source is a materialized output with its own digest and provenance.

compiler_obligation: Require a compilation receipt before relating generated source to compiled artifacts.
statement: Generated source is not a compiled object, binary, package or runtime occurrence.

compiler_obligation: Give each distinct identity, version and digest fields.
statement: A package contains distributable material; a deployment manifest declares desired controller input.

compiler_obligation: Require controller/runtime observation receipts.
statement: A deployment manifest is not proof that a running occurrence exists or matches desired state.

compiler_obligation: Persist the resolved graph independently of build action results.
statement: Dependency resolution selects a concrete graph; build execution performs actions over that graph.

compiler_obligation: Track reproducibility and conformance verdicts independently.
statement: Bit-for-bit reproducibility shows equality under tested rebuild conditions; it does not prove semantic correctness or contract conformance.

compiler_obligation: Never satisfy a provenance obligation with an SBOM or vice versa.
statement: An SBOM inventories components and relationships; provenance claims how a subject was produced from inputs by a builder.

compiler_obligation: Evaluate claim evidence after signature verification.
statement: A valid signature authenticates a signer and statement bytes under a trust policy; it does not establish that the signed claim is true.

compiler_obligation: Require an independent state compatibility or recovery plan.
statement: Redeploying a prior artifact does not reverse database, queue, object-store or external side effects.

compiler_obligation: Compare normalized required and offered feature sets.
statement: Every required target feature must be supplied by the deployment CPU/runtime; optimization-only features may not become hidden requirements.

compiler_obligation: Discharge an ABI proof for every foreign edge.
statement: FFI compatibility requires matching calling convention, layout, symbol, ownership, unwind and runtime contracts, not merely matching type names.

compiler_obligation: Run core validation and import resolution.
statement: A core Wasm consumer is compatible only when imports/exports and enabled proposals validate structurally and semantically.

compiler_obligation: Resolve versioned WIT worlds before composition.
statement: A component binding requires compatible WIT package/world identities and canonical ABI semantics.

compiler_obligation: Evaluate the declared writer/reader or producer/consumer compatibility mode.
statement: Schema compatibility is directional and consumer-specific; syntactic schema validity is insufficient.

compiler_obligation: Classify changes per surface before assigning a version.
statement: Version compatibility applies only to a named public surface and declared audience.

compiler_obligation: Perform discovery and server-side validation before mutation.
statement: A manifest must target an API version served by the destination and satisfy its schema/admission policy.

compiler_obligation: Include typed-IR digest in backend action keys.
statement: Any semantic typed-IR digest change invalidates every downstream backend action that consumes it.

compiler_obligation: Hash generator closure and decisions.
statement: Generator executable, version and configuration changes invalidate generated outputs even when input schemas are unchanged.

compiler_obligation: Hash the full template closure.
statement: Template bytes, imports and bound parameters are distinct action-key inputs.

compiler_obligation: Key actions by resolved identities and content digests.
statement: A resolved dependency graph or checksum change invalidates actions whose declared closure changes.

compiler_obligation: Hash resolved features per target partition.
statement: The normalized feature closure is an input even when source files are identical.

compiler_obligation: Hash the normalized target contract.
statement: Target tuple, features, ABI and sysroot changes invalidate target artifacts.

compiler_obligation: Use content-addressed toolchain closures.
statement: Compiler, linker, formatter, generator and sysroot digests participate in action identity.

compiler_obligation: Provide a deny-by-default environment allowlist.
statement: Every allowed result-affecting environment variable must be declared and keyed; undeclared observation is a hermeticity failure.

compiler_obligation: Trace or sandbox reads and compare them to declarations.
statement: Build-script rerun declarations must conservatively cover all result-affecting reads.

compiler_obligation: Keep AST and formatted-text keys separate.
statement: Formatter version and profile changes invalidate canonical generated text but need not invalidate pre-format AST identity.

compiler_obligation: Hash the resolved schema graph and generator contract.
statement: Transitive schema imports, dialect and generator options participate in generated client keys.

compiler_obligation: Verify result digests and cache namespace policy.
statement: Matching action digests justify reuse only inside an accepted cache trust domain and digest policy.

compiler_obligation: Persist and deploy the resolved digest.
statement: Mutable repository tags may locate candidates but release and deployment identity must resolve to immutable digests.
